title: 100% cotton wash rags
text: 100% cotton wash rags. These are very sturdy and will work nicely for exactly what I purchased them for - scrubbing with the option to bleach when/if necessary.  They are fairly thick too.  I've purchased others in the past that might have been able to see through, so these are nice.  Inexpensive enough to replace when you need to.

product_metadata.title: Pacific Linens 60-Pack White 100% Cotton Towel Washcloths, Durable, Lightweight, Commercial Grade and Ultra Absorbent
features: QUALITY: 100% Ring Spun Cotton is prime choice for quality. These lightweight washcloths are great for using around the house for general cleaning. Commercial grade quality ideal for hospitality industry. Each cloth measures 12" by 12"

DURABILITY: Extremely durable washcloths with double stitched hemming along the edges will maintain quality. Our washcloths are made from 100% cotton providing a comfortable and soft touch that will last through many washes

FUNCTIONAL: Use these washcloths at the gym to wipe down machines, in the kitchen to tackle the dirty dishes, or around the house to wipe down furniture. Throw a few in the car for a convenient rag when it's needed
EASY CARE: Machine washable and quick dry. Washcloths can be washed with bleach for crisp cleaning
description: Our conveniently sized, fully functional, durable and long lasting washcloths could make your life much easier. They are handy around the house, in the kitchen, bathroom, or garage. Throw some in the car or gym back. Being that these are a 60 pack gives you many options. They are very durable, but also surprisingly soft. They are 100% Ring spun Cotton which does give them a soft yet crisp and clean feel. These washcloths are commercial grade, making them exceptional for hospitality industry.
Machine wash in warm water, ok to bleach, tumble dry at medium heat, remove promptly.
